get.description:
The original file. PDFs and images open inline (citations link to `#page=N`); text and
HTML are shown as plain text; Office files download. Never executable in the browser.

post.description: Starts a run (202). Follow it with `GET /runs/{id}/events`.
A bundle (JSON) with the chosen items, downloaded as a file.

Dry run by default: the report says what would be created, extended, renamed or skipped
and why an item cannot be imported. Send again with `dry_run: false` to apply.

get.description: Every member sees the models the project can use (builders pick them in prompts).

post.description: Help Me Write on the project's `default-chat` alias (US-1.13.1).
Variables and template errors, for live feedback in the editor.

get.description: The call trace: latency, cost, usage, input messages, output, metadata.

post.description: The same prompt on 2 to 4 models in parallel (US-1.12.1).
Moves the `prod` tag: the prompt becomes Published in the library (US-1.11.2).
Render with the given variables and call the model; a model error is a failed run.
Save = a new immutable version, tagged `draft` (US-1.10.2).

get.description: The trace: retrieval ranking and timings, prompt messages, answer, cost and usage.

post.description: Retrieve, answer with citations, record the run. Model errors are failed runs.
Save Configuration = a new version; new index parameters start a new knowledge base.
The stop button: ends the run `cancelled` (own runs; Builders can stop any run).

get.description:
Server-sent events of a run: replay from the start (or `Last-Event-ID`), then follow.

Event types: run_started, run_resumed, step_started, token, step_finished, citations, done,
error. The stream ends after `done` or `error`.
Daily totals of runs (tokens, cost); they equal the sums of the runs' steps.
The process is up. Never touches dependencies, so restarts are not triggered by them.
Dependencies needed to serve traffic are reachable.
